objective: Lower canonical CompositionIR editor features into deterministic physical F06 execution, provide deterministic physical preview, and connect a command-driven Studio surface without creating a second authority.

rulesConsidered: Editor runtime cannot select compute providers or become economic, governance, rendering or release authority.
Production rendering remains behind OKF, RenderFabric, ComputeRouter, CAS and F07.
OpenCut, WASM, Rust compositor and isolated-plugin runtime capabilities remain unproven unless separately physically verified.
Unsupported render feature operations fail closed.

changes: Lowered transforms, animation/keyframes, effects, masks and transitions into RenderIntent.
Added deterministic F06 feature lowering and fail-closed unsupported operation handling.
Added physical VIDEO frame decoding with source-in and playback-rate semantics.
Added FFmpeg audio retiming, source spans, offsets, volume, fades and multi-track mixing.
Added explicit solid, gradient and blur backgrounds.
Added deterministic physical preview PNG via canonical RenderFabric normalization and FrameEngine.
Bound the complete lowered feature graph into deterministic render identity.
Added durable authenticated Studio runtime API and session rehydration.
Added command-driven Studio timeline, snapping, inspector, keyframes, effects, masks, transitions, backgrounds, audio/caption lanes and preview controls.
Added feature-lowering unit and physical editor-to-F06-to-CAS-to-F07 coverage.
